'''Knub Lairotide's Speeders''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] hire franchise that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It had a branch in [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility|Hedrett Groundport]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
